audience: marketers and growth teams who share short links tracked in Dub

useCases.title: Find your top links by clicks
useCases.text: The AI reads aggregated click analytics grouped by top links, and lists the links behind them. You get a ranked list for the period you ask about.

useCases.title: Break down clicks, leads and sales
useCases.text: The AI reads analytics grouped by country, device or referer, and lists single click, lead and sale events for detail.

useCases.title: Find links by tag, folder or domain
useCases.text: The AI lists links filtered by domain, tag, folder or a text search, and counts them by group. You get the set of links you need.

useCases.title: Create or change a short link
useCases.text: The AI creates a short link, or changes a link's destination, key, tags or archived state. It can update many links one by one.

useCases.title: Review and answer affiliate applications
useCases.text: The AI lists pending applications to the affiliate programme. It approves or rejects the ones you choose.

useCases.title: Check affiliate commissions and payouts
useCases.text: The AI reads commissions by affiliate, status or time window, payouts with their status, and clicks, leads, sales and revenue per affiliate.
